name: Abuku ni Miirareta Hitozuma
source:
Akane Tendouji is invited by Daiki Banjou to the 'soap land' that he runs.
When she sees the brothel, the seedy atmosphere makes her a little reluctant to enter.
Akane is here to ask about a job.

As with any soapland, it’s an establishment where customers can come to have their bodies bathed.
If they meet the right requirements, customers can do whatever they want when they’re being bathed.
And if regular customers pay an additional fee, well... let’s just say you have to be an adult.

That explanation only makes Akane all the more confused.
But Daiki is quite taken by Akane, and insists that she works for him. Considering how frustrated she is with her everyday life, she hesitantly agrees.

Akane signs the contract, and Daiki immediately requests her to clean him as part of her training.
He leads her to the bathroom, suds her breasts with body soap, and makes her clean his body with them.

But Akane likes to do naughty things. Though she does feel a little nervous to be doing this with a man she’s only just met, she exposes her body to him without shame and gets to work.
Although she likes getting freaky, she doesn’t have much experience, and she hasn’t done it with her husband in a while, so she leaves a lot to be desired with her first session.
Daiki tells her that isn’t going to be good enough, and decides to guide her...

Eventually, Akane becomes capable enough to work at the store, and Daiki decides which customers get to partner up with her.
And if he thinks those customers seem good enough, he introduces them to Akane...

天道寺茜被万城大辉邀请到他经营的泡泡浴店。当她看到这家风俗店时，淫靡的氛围让她有点不想进去。茜是来找工作的。和所有泡泡浴一样，这是一个顾客可以来享受洗浴服务的场所。如果满足特定条件，顾客在洗浴时可以为所欲为。如果老顾客额外付费的话……嗯，总之只有成年人才行。这番解释只让茜更加困惑。但大辉对茜非常着迷，坚持要她来工作。考虑到她对日常生活的沮丧，她犹豫地答应了。茜签了合同，大辉立刻要求她为他清洗身体作为训练的一部分。他把她带到浴室，在她的胸部上涂满沐浴露，让她用胸部清洗他的身体。但茜喜欢做淫荡的事。虽然和刚认识的男人做这种事让她有些紧张，但她毫无羞耻地暴露自己的身体开始工作。虽然她喜欢刺激，但经验不多，而且很久没有和丈夫做了，所以第一次的表现还有很多不足。大辉告诉她这还不够好，决定指导她……最终，茜变得足够胜任店里的工作，大辉决定哪些客人可以和她搭档。如果他觉得那些客人够好，就会介绍给茜……
